metadata.source_note: Official 2026 Missouri Form MO-1040ES. The extracted Tax Rate Chart provides the published brackets and cumulative base amounts only for estimating 2026 Missouri individual income tax under Sections 143.011 and 143.021, RSMo. This source does not establish final Form MO-1040 liability, annual-return taxable-income construction, spouse allocation or aggregation, rounding, credits, withholding, payments or installments, underpayment additions, recapture or lump-sum tax, nonresident apportionment, or final-return ordering.
metadata.title: Missouri Form MO-1040ES, 2026 Declaration of Estimated Tax for Individuals
